chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The pregnant woman is divorced with one divorce.
ai.seo_question: How is a pregnant woman divorced according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes that a pregnant woman is divorced with a single pronouncement, a ruling derived from the specific waiting period (iddah) of pregnancy which ends at childbirth. It highlights the Shia scholarly view that the duration of iddah for pregnant women is independent of the menstrual cycle, thereby simplifying the divorce mechanism compared to non-pregnant cases. This ruling underscores the practical application of Quranic verses regarding iddah, ensuring clarity in marital status during the unique physiological state of pregnancy.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The pregnant woman is divorced with one divorce’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A pregnant woman is divorced once.’”
